item.title: ParaAir 0.1.0 alpha 8
item.description:
• Team owners and admins can manage members in Storage Settings: invite by email, change roles, remove people.
  • Delete your ParaAir Cloud account from Storage Settings, with a grace period you can cancel.
  • Legal pages are linked from About, the sign-in and the plan sheet; a team's plan shows as shared storage.
  • Remove from List… for drives you no longer use.
  • Fewer requests to ParaAir Cloud: a quiet drive is checked about once a minute, and every 3 seconds again as soon as anything changes.

item.title: ParaAir 0.1.0 alpha 7
item.description:
• ParaAir Cloud folders open right away: a folder listed in the last 30 seconds answers from this Mac instead of waiting on the network, and changes from other Macs still show within seconds.
  • Every drive in one window: drives set up in more than one place are all listed, each with its state and one button, and every problem names its drive.
  • Workspace owners and admins can manage members and make folder-scoped service credentials with the paraair command.
  • The Drive section shows the plan size in the same type as the other rows, and updates now come from paraair.parafield.ai.

item.title: ParaAir 0.1.0 alpha 6
item.description:
• Shared drives stay in step across Macs (macOS 27): files and folders changed, renamed, restored or deleted on another Mac show their new state here within seconds.
  • Guided setup: turning on ParaAir's drive in System Settings comes first, with a picture of the right switch, and ParaAir moves on by itself once it's on.
  • Updates keep the drive switched on; if macOS ever turns it off, ParaAir says so and shows the one-click step.
  • Sign-in while the screen is locked recovers by itself once the Mac is unlocked.

item.title: ParaAir 0.1.0 alpha 3
item.description:
• A new app icon in the macOS 26 style.
  • When an update is ready, ParaAir says so in its menu bar panel and window instead of an alert that can open behind other apps.
  • Setup points to the switch that works: System Settings, Login Items & Extensions, By Category, File System Extensions.
  • Buttons match the size and shape of the macOS buttons beside them.
  • Installing from the disk image no longer leaves a stale copy registered with macOS.

item.title: ParaAir 0.1.0 alpha 2
item.description:
• ParaAir now updates itself. Before installing an update it ejects its drives; files waiting to upload stay on your Mac and upload afterwards.
  • Connect Cloudflare R2 with an R2 API token, from any Cloudflare account.
  • A new look that matches paraair.pages.dev, with clearer text in Light mode.
  • Opening ParaAir from the disk image moves it to Applications, and it opens at login.
  • The version, with its alpha number, is in Advanced and About ParaAir.
